scheme_name: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates
other_conditions: Must belong to SC or ST category.
Must have obtained a graduate degree in the relevant subject.
Must have admission to a regular full‑time first‑year postgraduate professional course in a recognized university/institution/college.
The institution must be covered under UGC Act sections 2(f)&12(B), deemed universities under section 3, funded by central/state government, or institutes of national importance.
Professional courses are those approved by regulatory councils such as MCI, DCI, PCI, RCI, NCTIS, NCTE, BCI, AICTE, ICAR, INC, etc.
Only students pursuing the first year of the postgraduate program in the current academic year are eligible.
Scholarship renewal is subject to good conduct, attendance, and timely submission of a progress report.
Failure to pass the first year with first division or equivalent CGPA, discontinuation of studies, or providing false information leads to cancellation.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹7,800 per month for professional courses (ME/M.Tech) or ₹4,500 per month for other courses, payable for up to the duration of the postgraduate program (2‑3 years).
